charts.title: WASP-17 b: orbits around Dìwö
charts.description: The orbits of Dìwö's planets in this map from above, to scale, with WASP-17 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 3.73548545 d

charts.title: WASP-17 b: its transit
charts.description: WASP-17 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (12, 38, 91) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 66818296, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 18-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 18-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
